questions.question:
In a certain code, P + Q means 'Q is the son of P'; P @ Q means 'Q is the daughter of P'; P $ Q means 'Q is the brother of P'; P % Q means 'P is the father of Q' and P # Q means 'P is the mother of Q'.

Which of the following is true?

options.text: C @ D $ F % G means G is the grandson of C.
A + B $ C % D means A is the maternal grandfather of D.
K + L $ M @ N means N is the granddaughter of K.
G % H # K $ L means L is the son-in-law of G.

questions.solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36599e00c5f3cd5eceb3f9cbbc632b5ff566dcb577e6b56253f1be4781571713.png] 

Let us first decode the given symbol and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 @
 $
 %
 #
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Daughter
 Brother
 Father
 Mother
 
 

Option 1) C @ D $ F % G means G is the grandson of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992115d34122cb7bf23bb78a5ea643a8af7d6e0072011ff59033cf599be86ebe.png] 

False, here the gender of **G **is not clear, So we can't say that **G **is the grandson of **C.**

Option 2) A + B $ C % D means A is the maternal grandfather of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec2871039ffcd3f0c1ecdd97a418e05d3a38b5e0613fcdfe7fe1b162d7beeadc.png] 

False, here the gender of **A **is not clear, So we can't say that **A **is grandfather of D.

Option 3) K + L $ M @ N means N is the granddaughter of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cbdc33fc3a85df2f71c29e296669d3eba6a18c4f534e97de01c4774e4165e6c.png] 

**True, **here the gender of **N **is clear she is a female, So **N **is the granddaughter of **K **is correct.

Option 4) G % H # K $ L means L is the son-in-law of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d898196e18ccf688af25b3283a6e15641033c7605c342f930856717702324ff5.png] 

False, here **L **is not a son-in-law of **G. **Because **L **is the grandson of **G.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No Lilly is a Rose.

All Roses are Jasmines.

**Conclusions:**

I. No Lilly is a Jasmine.

II. No Jasmine is a Lilly.

III. Some Jasmines are Roses.

IV. All Jasmines are Roses.

options.text: Both conclusions I and IV follow.
Both conclusions I and II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c680819a5a6acacc41faf79b4bf42edf82591c9f15ff19a41e00d9534c45624.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No Lilly is a Jasmine → False → (As all rose are jasmine and no lilly are rose. So no lilly is jasmine is possible but not definite)

II. No Jasmine is a Lilly → False → (As all rose are jasmine and no lilly are rose. So no jasmine is a lilly is possible but not definite)

III. Some Jasmines are Roses → True → (As all rose are jasmine, so some jasmines are roses is definite true)

IV. All Jasmines are Roses → False → (As all rose are jasmine, so all jasmines are roses it not possible)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

3 ∶ 9 ∶∶ 8 ∶ ? ∶∶ 0 ∶ 2
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is

**(Number)² - 1 : (Number)³ + 1**

**For 3 : 9 →**

Number = 2

2² -1 : 2³ + 1

⇒ 4 - 1 : 8 + 1

⇒ 3 : 9

And 

For 0 : 2 →

Number = 1

1² - 1 : 1³ + 1 

⇒ 1 - 1 : 1 + 1

⇒ 0 : 2

Similarly,

**For 8 ∶ ? →**

3² - 1 : 3³ + 1

⇒ 9 - 1 : 27 + 1

⇒ 8 : 28

Hence the correct answer is "28".

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Z K _ R _ Z _ M R _ Z K M _ T _ K M _ T

options.text: M T K T R T R
M T K Z R Z R
M T K T R Z R
Z T K T R Z R

questions.solution:
Given: Z K _ R _ Z _ M R _ Z K M _ T _ K M _ T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) M T K T R T R → Z K **M **R **T** - Z **K**** **M R **T**** **- Z K M **R**** **T - **T**** **K M **R **T

2) M T K Z R Z R → Z K M R T - Z K M R **Z** - Z K M R T - **Z** K M R T

3) M T K T R Z R → Z K M R T - Z K M R T - Z K M R T - **Z** K M R T

4) Z T K T R Z R → Z K **Z** R T - Z K M R T - Z K M R T - **Z** K M R T

The cycle of word is: Z K **M** R T / Z K M R T / Z K M R T/ Z K M R T

Hence, the correct answer is **"M T K T R Z R".**
